name: AWS GuardDuty
description: Receive AWS GuardDuty threat detection findings via webhook

setup_guide.title: Forward GuardDuty findings
steps: In AWS Console, go to EventBridge → Rules → Create rule
Select 'GuardDuty Finding' as the event pattern
Add an API destination target pointing to the Hakuna webhook URL

sample_payload: {"version":"0","source":"aws.guardduty","detail-type":"GuardDuty Finding","detail":{"id":"d2b4c5e6-1234-5678-abcd-ef9012345678","type":"UnauthorizedAccess:IAMUser/MaliciousIPCaller","severity":8,"title":"API GenerateDataKey was invoked from a known malicious IP address","updatedAt":"2024-03-15T10:30:00Z","region":"us-east-1","resource":{"resourceType":"AccessKey"},"service":{"action":{"networkConnectionAction":{"remoteIpDetails":{"ipAddressV4":"198.51.100.42"}}}}}}
